description: Comptages vélos (pas horaire) is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Comptages vélos horaires collectés par les compteurs vélos permanents du Département des Hauts-de-Seine Dans le cadre de sa politique en faveur des mobilités douces, le Département des Hauts-de-Seine a souhaité se doter d’un outil de suivi et d’observation de la fréquentation cyclable. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Transport / Mobilité. Its keywords are compteurs, vélos, pistes cyclables, bandes cyclables, comptages. The portal shows 463,266 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
